strings: All of m_c's wobbling has left {PRONOUN/m_c/object} exhausted and sore. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} {VERB/m_c/duck/ducks} into the medicine cat den, asking r_c for herbs that can hopefully lessen the pain.

m_c grimaces as {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/feel/feels} sore all over. With a wobbly walk, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/sink/sinks} back into {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} nest, hoping sleep can make the pain go away.
